hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; f=working.md; c="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-rules-$f"; [ -s "$c" ] || rm -f "$c.etag"; code=$(curl -sS -m 10 --etag-compare "$c.etag" --etag-save "$c.etag.new" -o "$c.new" -w "%{http_code}" "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/temirvvs/claude-code-config/main/rules/$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$code" = 200 ] && [ -s "$c.new" ]; then mv "$c.new" "$c"; mv "$c.etag.new" "$c.etag"; fi; rm -f "$c.new" "$c.etag.new"; if [ -s "$c" ]; then cat "$c"; else echo "Global rules file rules/$f could not be fetched (HTTP ${code:-none}). Tell the user."; fi
